name: agent-workflows
description: Personal workflow skills for agent task planning and execution.

interface.longDescription: A local skills-only plugin for reusable agent workflows such as approval-gated development, evidence-driven diagnostics, coding guidelines, output formatting, Git initialization and operation discipline with conditional staging and author identity error handling, adaptive documentation-backed plan stress-testing, and task execution discipline. It intentionally does not ship MCP servers.
defaultPrompt: Use workflows-dev when a non-trivial change must be researched, planned, explicitly approved, implemented, and verified as one controlled workflow.
Use workflows-evidence-diagnostics only when repeated failures, conflicting evidence, diverging source/generated/runtime states, or rollback risk require explicit diagnosis.
Apply workflows-output-formatting to any dense user-facing response so it keeps important details while becoming easier to read.
Apply workflows-guidelines to keep non-trivial engineering edits simple, surgical, and verifiable.

Apply workflows-git-operations before initializing repositories, creating branches, conditionally staging after separate index and worktree inspection, committing, handling Git author identity errors, pulling, pushing, rolling back, or clearing stale Git index locks.
Use Workflows Grill With Docs to adaptively stress-test a plan and capture settled terminology or durable decisions in the target repository.
